method CountOpeningBrackets(brackets: string) returns (count: int)
    requires brackets != null
    ensures count >= 0

method CountClosingBrackets(brackets: string) returns (count: int)

method PrefixBalance(brackets: string, index: int) returns (balance: int)
    requires brackets != null && 0 <= index && index < brackets.Length
    ensures balance == CountOpeningBrackets(substr(brackets, 0, index + 1)) 
                     - CountClosingBrackets(substr(brackets, 0, index + 1))
    ensures balance >= 0
